- 999 ÷ 6 = 166, remainder 3
- 166 ÷ 6 = 27, remainder 4
- 27 ÷ 6 = 4, remainder 3
- 4 ÷ 6 = 0, remainder 4

Reading the remainders upward gives $4343_6$.
